== Summary ==
Mug it up! Michael McLeod of Edmonton, Alberta is a Star Trek CCG finalist. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999#Star Trek CCG World Championship|Star Trek CCG at DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
